common.unreachable: The manager could not be reached.

login.title: Sign in
login.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.

change.title: Change the password.
change.why: This account still carries the password it was given when the manager was deployed. Nothing else opens until it is replaced.

admins.title: Administrators
admins.lead: An administrator is a replicated fact, written in this replica's own scope. The password is hashed on the replica and never stored, logged or replicated.
admins.conflict: written in more than one scope
admins.createLead: Written in scope {{scope}}; it replicates to the other replicas.
admins.newHint: At least 12 characters; not the login.
admins.revokeMessage: The account stops signing in on every replica once the revocation has replicated. This is an observation like any other; it is not undone, a new account is created instead.

status.title: This replica
status.lead: What the publisher contract exposes: the logical manager, this replica, and the epoch at which it was marked the active manager.

none.title: No administrator exists yet.
none.why: The first administrator is not created from this page. It is written on the host that carries the active manager, as root, through PodMesh's control door; a deployment does it.
none.doctrine: What has power has no front door. Once one administrator is on record, that administrator names the next ones here.

closed.title: Not the active manager
closed.why: This replica does not hold the role; it administers nothing.

error.title: The page could not be drawn.
error.why: A drawing error sends nothing to the manager. Reload the page; if it happens again, the manager answered something this version of the page does not expect.
